text: {"lessons":["Selling part of a position at a gain has felt satisfying, but I should decide whether to sell based on the investment outlook—not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","Doing nothing through ordinary month-to-month swings has worked so far; I need not trade just because prices move.","My average cost is not a reason to keep a losing stock or sell a sound one. I should judge each holding on its prospects and manage risk calmly."]}
